_meta.description: clients-reversible-merge D1: client and contact take part in OpenRegister's reversible merge (merge#preview, merge#execute, merge#reverse) with a thirty-day reversal window. accountStatus gains merged; contact gets a recordStatus for the same purpose. mergeMovedRows is the ledger ClientMergeReferenceListener keeps on the merged-away record (D2).

accountStatus.title: Account status
accountStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the CRM relationship/account record (distinct from the contact identity). merged: OpenRegister merged this client into another one.

mergeMovedRows.title: References moved by the merge
mergeMovedRows.description: The rows whose reference to this record were moved onto the record it was merged into, as schema, row uuid and property, so a reversal moves exactly those back. Empty while the record stands on its own.

recordStatus.title: Record status
recordStatus.description: Whether the contact stands on its own or was merged into another contact record.
